title: THE GARDENER OF BORROWED BONES

rounds.summary: R14 preflight. Aim: keep Halden Reach sheltered through the glass storm, stop involuntary mineral extraction, and keep Oruun and the living houses as partners. Counterpart: Oruun's covenant is kinship, and it misread sleeping occupancy as the giving song. Strongest objection (scene 2): a wall made from no one belongs to no one. Decisive understanding: houses need structural minerals plus a named, chosen giver; the wall remembers a hand. Love in action: Illuminara lets Oruun show her the return cycle, refuses to feed a house for anyone, honours Hana Brisk's refusal, and lets the families and a child define the human covenant. Earned change: Oruun accepts a revocable, chosen gift without welcoming it yet. Positive result: the settlement holds through the storm, extraction stops, children begin treatment, future dwellings require explicit participation. Remaining cost: one house (the Brisk house) cracks, Oruun grieves, rehabilitation will take time. Power holds the gable and sequences the ring but decides nothing between beings. Named speakers: Illuminara, Oruun, Ilo Penn, Hana Brisk, Tavi Brisk.

A vivid, unusually economical R14 draft with a concrete sixteen-hour rescue, a coherent alien covenant, a strong freely exercised refusal and a costly positive result. Oruun is not excused or flattened: understanding its return cycle changes the intervention, while Hana and Tavi keep authority over the harmed household. Three bounded revisions would keep the mineral answer from feeling magically convenient, earn Oruun's change through a visible voluntary act, and reconcile the settlement scale and promised medical outcome.

Bounded S2 revision answering all three source-bound T02 priorities while preserving the six-scene story, the failed anonymous feed, the old woman's return cycle, Oruun's strongest objection, the long-table covenant, Hana's refusal, the Brisk house's real loss and the restrained dawn ending. The long-table scene now includes one falsifiable pilot: Penn freely names a measured gift, Oruun retunes the receiving song, the wall forms a physical bond, and an analyser verifies that extraction stops. Oruun itself closes the inherited sleeping-song, accepts the storm risk and keeps that limit in force while the unfed house waits. Population and household counts are reconciled at 4,600 people in 412 households; 411 walls are fed and one fails. At dawn Penn begins Tavi's first repair treatment without implying instant recovery.

T03 answers all three T02 priorities inside the same six scenes (2,439 words against 2,105) and the additions earn their space. The pilot at the long table is now a physical, timed test rather than an assertion: Penn names her own gift, the powder first crusts, Oruun retunes one note, the panel thickens two millimetres and the analyser stays level. Oruun's change is now an act with a price (it folds a root, silences the inherited sleeping-song, spends twelve minutes of storm strength and keeps the ear shut at the unfed Brisk house), the counts are mostly reconciled (4,600 people, 412 households, 411 fed walls, one loss), and Penn clips the first treatment line at dawn without a recovery montage. The protected core is intact: the wall that healed around a sleeping boy, the old woman's open hand, 'a wall made from no one belongs to no one', the failed anonymous feed, Tavi's 'Her hand', Hana's refusal, the broken Brisk house and 'They were no longer thinning.' Two small things still stand between this and a final. First, the pilot's key result is over-credited: extraction stops because Oruun shut the old ear, which happens in the test panel whether or not the named gift is poured, so the test as written does not show what the named gift itself does; and the claim the story most needs the reader to believe (named, chosen minerals keep a wall strong without bone) is carried only by a two-millimetre thickening. Second, the opening still contradicts itself on scale: Penn's '206 residents ... the other forty on the ridge' reads as the whole settlement, against 4,600 people in 412 households. Both are one- or two-sentence repairs; neither needs a new speaker, scene or subplot.

Final preserves all six scenes, the existing five speakers and every protected passage. Only T04's two bounded repairs were made. The pilot now compares adjacent panels with both old ears closed: only Penn's named mineral gift keeps its panel strong, while the unfed control thins and neither draws from her body. The opening identifies 206 scans as a sample, and the close distinguishes noon calcium tracers from dawn structural scans. Illuminara's powers still protect and sequence; understanding, Oruun's voluntary limit and the residents' freely named gifts decide the conflict. Hana's refusal, the broken Brisk house, Oruun's grief and the children's incomplete recovery remain.

T05 makes both T04 repairs and nothing else. Priority point 1: the pilot now compares two adjacent panels with the old ear closed in both, so the two causal claims are visibly separate (closing the ear stops bodily extraction; only the named gift keeps its panel strong, while the unfed neighbour thins by half a millimetre and Penn's trace stays level). Priority point 2: the opening line makes the 206 scans a screened sample with forty tent sleepers as comparison, and the close separates the noon tracers from the dawn structural scans. Six scenes, the five speakers and every protected passage are intact; no speaker, scene or subplot was added.

final_critic_line: The living houses of Halden Reach had been drawing calcium from the bones of everyone who slept in them; Illuminara learned what Oruun's covenant meant, found the one answer to its objection, and a gift each family could name, give or refuse kept four hundred and eleven houses standing through the glass storm.
